FN-G3IYF2C-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 261
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ontario Tillman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/02/2026
House Bill 261 as introduced would provide for individuals whose records are expunged
pursuant to this bill to forgo the payment of the existing $500 filing fee, which is distributed as
follows:
AMOUNT FUND/AGENCY
$75 State Judicial Administrative Fund
$25 Department of Forensic Sciences
$50 District Attorney's Office
$50 Clerk's Office of Circuit Court
$50 Public Safety Fund
$50 County General Fund of arresting law enforcement agency
$100 State General Fund
$50 Education Trust Fund
$50 Fair Trial Tax Fund
Page 1

FN-G3IYF2C-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 261
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Ontario Tillman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/11/2026
House Bill 261 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would provide for individuals to
have a boating violation expunged, pursuant to this bill.
This could increase receipts to the following funds below upon payment of the existing $500
filing fee, which is distributed as follows:
AMOUNT FUND/AGENCY
$75 State Judicial Administrative Fund
$25 Department of Forensic Sciences
$50 District Attorney's Office
$50 Clerk's Office of Circuit Court
$50 Public Safety Fund
$50 County General Fund of arresting law enforcement agency
$100 State General Fund
$50 Education Trust Fund
$50 Fair Trial Tax Fund
Page 1
